description: Time applied when the user first picks a date on an empty TmDateTimePicker. Midnight (default) keeps today's 00:00:00; Now uses the injected TimeProvider (fallback TimeProvider.System).

values.name: Midnight
values.description: 00:00:00 — today's behaviour when the user first picks a date on an empty picker.

values.name: Now
values.description: The current local time of the injected TimeProvider (fallback TimeProvider.System).
